schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Track the explicit Corepack pin in the Dockerfile and README install instructions; no built-in manager sees a version inside a shell command or prose.

packageRules.description: typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0; TS 7 breaks type-aware lint (see CLAUDE.md Versions)

Stay on Node 24 LTS until the planned move to Node 26 after 2026-10-28. Covers every Node version pin: the docker `node` image (Dockerfile), `.nvmrc` and `actions/setup-node`'s `node-version:` (node-version datasource, depName `node`).
nginx's odd minor versions are mainline releases. Keep the unprivileged image on the stable line (even minor), which is what its stable-alpine tag tracks.
Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once the required checks pass.
Majors always wait for a human.
The pinned toolchain always waits for a human.
